player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Iceman''') posted a [[Dark]] [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]] list on DeckTech in August 1999.
description: This deck is sorta a variant of an old DnDrain deck that went 18-0 for me in tournament play. It doesn't win by huge differential though.
cards: A Bright Center To The Universe
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: The strategy names starting choices by matchup (e.g. Imperial Square and Imperial Arrest Order against Hidden Base), so no single starting Effect is set.

Posted '5d6' dested 5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix); 'Bus' Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Punishing One', 'IG-2000' and 'Mist Hunter' the Dagobah starships as posted; 'Vader's Shuttle' Vader's Personal Shuttle; 'ABC2 The Uni' A Bright Center To The Universe; 'Hell2Pay' There'll Be Hell To Pay; 'Twi'lek' Twi'lek Advisor; 'Lars Moisture Farm', 'Jundland Wastes', 'Cantina', 'Tusken Canyon' the Tatooine sites. Secret Plans and Oppressive Enforcement are the pre-Reflections III Effects.
player_note: The post's description says the deck is 'sorta a variant of an old DnDrain deck that went 18-0 for me in tournament play' (no event named; that record belongs to the older deck).
